system.description:
Requirements: You must be utilizing Zephyr Style

Cost: 1 Focus

Range: 5 Spaces

The wind lifts you and your ally, setting you both down where the other stood.

On your turn, you may spend 1 Focus to exchange positions with a willing ally your Size or smaller, or an unattended object of your weight or less, that you can see within 5 spaces of you.

Nothing solid may stand between you and the target.

Neither movement triggers attacks or effects that respond to movement, and you do not touch the ground during movement.

You cannot use this ability while you or your chosen target are Restrained.
